_comment: Manufacturer URLs and official thiol statements, verified against product pages 2026-09-02 (Crossref/manufacturer). Display names come from yeast_names.json.

wyeast1318.note: No thiol/biotransformation claim; page says it 'balances well with the tropical fruit qualities from late and dry hop additions'.

imperial_juice.note: No thiol claim; Imperial describes ester profile bringing out new-school hop aromas.

lalbrew_verdant.thiol_claim: Through expression of a β-lyase enzyme, LalBrew Verdant IPA can promote hop biotransformation and accentuate hop flavor and aroma.
lalbrew_verdant.note: The β-lyase sentence is on the 2023 technical data sheet (https://admin.lallemandbrewing.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/TDS_LPS_BREWINGYEAST_VERDANT_ENG_A4-4.pdf); the current web product description omits it. Lallemand's 2026 thiol article classes Verdant IPA as a 'medium-high thiol freeing strain'

us05.note: No thiol claim; described as neutral, 'ideal for American beer types and highly hopped beers'.

wlp001.note: No thiol claim; 'accentuates hop flavors and aromas'.

kveik_voss.note: ASSUMPTION: the app id 'kveik_voss' is mapped to LalBrew Voss (dry) as the most widely available Voss product; the same culture (from Sigmund Gjernes) is also sold by other labs (e.g., Omega 'Voss Kveik' OYL-061, Imperial 'Loki' A43, Escarpment 'Voss Kveik'), none of which were verified here. No thi

bry97.thiol_claim: Through expression of a β-glucosidase enzyme, LalBrew BRY-97 can promote hop biotransformation and accentuate hop flavor and aroma.
bry97.note: Claim is about β-glucosidase (glycoside release), not β-lyase/thiols. Lallemand also offers a 'Biotransformation Info Sheet' for this strain.

cosmic_punch.thiol_claim: A Thiolized version of British Ale V (OYL-011), Cosmic Punch generates thiols through biotransformation, releasing tropical aromas like those in Southern Hemisphere hops and New Zealand Sauvignon blanc; the current page describes 'bound thiols unlocked at a complementary level, not a dominant one'.
cosmic_punch.note: Current page fetched; the longer statement is from Omega's 2022 Probrew brochure and retailer copies of Omega's description. Engineered (IRC7 activation, patent pending); Omega notes engineered strains are for sale in the US only.

star_party.thiol_claim: A Thiolized version of the beloved Chico strain (West Coast Ale I), Star Party is a thiol burst with aromas of passion fruit, dank pink guava, and citrus zest.
star_party.note: Page (2022 URL format) fetched via search index; 'For sale in the US only. Patent pending.' Uses the PatB carbon-sulfur lyase per Omega's guide.

thiol_libre.thiol_claim: Thiol Libre liberates tropical thiol aromas from your hops and malt; thanks to the thiol compound 3-MHA and others, beers fermented with Thiol Libre have enhanced guava and passionfruit aromas.
thiol_libre.note: Page fetched. Escarpment uses no numeric strain code. Page states the strain was updated in June 2023 to be non-phenolic; at fetch time it showed 'not in stock / apply to buy'.

berkeley_tropics.thiol_claim: TROPICS strains are engineered to pack a tropical punch reminiscent of the finest southern-hemisphere hops, delivering a burst of thiols that unlock vibrant notes of guava, grapefruit, and passion fruit.
berkeley_tropics.note: 'Tropics' is a product family, not a single strain; individual product page e.g. https://berkeleyyeast.com/products/tropics-london. Berkeley also sells 'TROPICS BOOST™', a plant-derived precursor extract. Related peer-reviewed work: molitor_2022.

lalbrew_pomona.thiol_claim: A fruity, stress-tolerant, and robust hybrid strain (developed with Escarpment Laboratories) that enhances biotransformation and haze for modern IPA styles.
lalbrew_pomona.note: Page fetched (published Apr 2024). Lallemand's 2026 split-batch article measured Pomona at 38% higher 3SH than Verdant IPA and classes both as 'medium-high thiol freeing strains'.

novalager.note: No thiol claim in the product description; marketed as a Group III S. cerevisiae x S. eubayanus hybrid with patented UC Davis H2S-inhibiting technology and low VDK.

lalbrew_neipa.thiol_claim: Through expression of a β-glucosidase enzyme, LalBrew New England can promote hop biotransformation and accentuate hop flavor and aroma.
lalbrew_neipa.note: Claim is β-glucosidase (glycoside) based, not thiol/β-lyase.

wlp077_tropicale.thiol_claim: This is a blend of non-GMO yeast strains that have been carefully selected to aid in the release of bound thiol compounds by targeting high enzymatic B-lyase activity.
wlp077_tropicale.note: Blend, non-GMO; White Labs' WLP830 page says the blend research identified WLP037 and WLP830 as high potential β-lyase strains.

lutra_kveik.note: No thiol claim; 'shockingly clean' neutral house strain. Dried version is OYL-071DRY.

hornindal_kveik.note: No thiol claim; tropical/stone-fruit ester character described as complementing fruit-forward hops.

imperial_a04.note: No thiol claim; 'Conan'-type strain with stone-fruit esters.

lalbrew_bellesaison.thiol_claim: Through expression of a β-glucosidase enzyme, LalBrew Belle Saison can promote hop biotransformation and accentuate hop flavor and aroma in hoppy saison-style beers.
lalbrew_bellesaison.note: S. cerevisiae var. diastaticus; claim is β-glucosidase based, not thiol.

wlp029_kolsch.note: Current official name is 'WLP029 Kölsch Ale Yeast' (retailers still list it as 'German Ale/Kölsch'). No thiol claim.

helio_gazer.thiol_claim: With enhanced Thiolized capabilities, Helio Gazer boosts thiol biotransformation to free thiols 200x above sensory threshold, creating a supernova of tropical, passion fruit flavors and aromas; the current page states 'Where Cosmic Punch complements, Helio Gazer dominates.'
helio_gazer.note: Thiolized British Ale V using PatB; Omega says it produces nearly 20x more thiols than Cosmic Punch. US only, patent pending. Spec discrepancy between old and current pages noted in the industry entry.

saflager_sh45.thiol_claim: This strain possesses the capability to release and esterify thiols; as a result, beers crafted with SafLager SH-45 may present enhanced levels of fruitiness and intensified citrus and tropical notes.
saflager_sh45.note: Product exists: S. pastorianus lager strain 'selected to enhance hop thiol release'; apparent attenuation 77-82%, 12-18°C, high esters, medium flocculation; formats 11.5 g/100 g/500 g/10 kg. Launch announced ~Nov 2025 (Fermentis news page and Independent Brewers Association advertorial dated 19 Nov

lalbrew_diamond.note: No thiol claim; S. pastorianus from the Doemens collection.

saflager_s23.note: No thiol claim; 'recommended for the production of fruitier and more estery lagers'.

whitelabs_wlp830.thiol_claim: From our research creating WLP077 Tropicale Yeast Blend, we found WLP037 Yorkshire Square Ale Yeast and WLP830 German Lager Yeast to have a relative high potential activity for beta-lyase biotransformation, which releases bound thiols from hops into free thiols (passionfruit and guava aromas).
whitelabs_wlp830.note: Statement appears on the official WLP830 page.
